source.method: Vendored polkit-agent subtree; local changes documented in README.md.

limitations: Static archive describes a legacy resource, not proof it is the active Tahoe runtime layout.
XPC helper nib resources omitted by bounded document selection.
No authorization request, password input, privileged action, UI capture or CUA interaction occurred.

implementation.startup: Replaces stock agent only in makOS session startup
implementation.icon: Original makOS lock SVG, not an extracted Apple asset

security_properties: Begin and Cancel requests must match current authority unique bus owner
No missing/invalid uid implicitly selects root
Password field and undo state cleared immediately after submission/cancel; owned response buffers overwritten after handoff
No credentials in argv, files, settings or logs; raw PAM/helper diagnostics are not forwarded
Exact success/failure records and successful helper exit required; completion never grants privileges by itself
No fake success UI or independent privilege bypass

validation.local: Portable C++ protocol test passed; C++ syntax checks for modified source and test files; Python session/staging compile passed.
validation.pending: Linux linking, real headless Toolkit dialog, fixture-helper process tests and installed-session registration/authorization remain pending CI/VM.

remaining_limits: Real user authorization must be tested in an installed Linux session; fixtures never authenticate an account.
Pixel parity with the current Tahoe authentication window has not been observed.
Original agent selects one allowed administrator (prefers current user); no administrator picker was added.
All password-copy erasure across toolkit, allocator and kernel memory cannot be guaranteed.
Fingerprint and other platform-specific native authorization UI are not implemented.
